artboards.title: 1 · First run — an empty Your subjects
4 · Lands in the editor, as drafts

annotations.text:
THE DIAGNOSIS

The dialog asks three unrelated things at once — a content choice, a taxonomy chore, and a second content choice — and it asks for the taxonomy even when it already knows the answer.

A teacher's mental model is not "create a subject entity". It is "I teach Class 10 Maths and I want to set a test."

THE PROPOSED FLOW — one question per step, and the taxonomy is a consequence rather than a question.

Empty state teaches the loop  →  Step 1: what do you teach?  →  Step 2: which tests?  →  land in the editor with drafts you can edit.
The other branch of Step 2. Only "Something else" has to ask for board, class and subject — and then it is the only thing on screen.
This is the screen that answers "where did my test go?" — the copies are drafts, students see nothing until Publish, and + adds another (blank or built-in). One banner, dismissed once.

AT SCALE — asked in the comments: what if there are 1000+ subjects?

Same step, same question. Cards up to ~6; a search box past that. Step 2 is unchanged either way.
